top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises one validated, transferable chemical principle: a small molecule induces a ternary complex between a chosen protein and an E3 ligase, turning occupancy-driven pharmacology into catalytic, event-driven degradation. It is supported by ternary-complex structures, kinetic cooperativity analysis and wide independent reproduction. Crews and Deshaies conceived and demonstrated the heterobifunctional concept, and Handa's identification of cereblon gives the glue strand its molecular basis, within the three-laureate limit. Attribution is lossy (Ciulli, Gray, Sakamoto, Kim, Ito) and no PROTAC drug is approved, but the criterion is the validated mechanism, not the pipeline. P002 is the mature, cleanly defined chemistry runner-up. P003 adds a younger, contested base-editing part. P004 is a principle whose in vivo scope is still disputed. A prize is preferred to no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; I am a Stockholm University colleague of Xiaodong Zou, but no slate laureate is connected to me
